title: 第26章 你的身后是万家灯火

第26章 你的身后是万家灯火-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

顾承安是坐基地的公务车回城的。

就是一辆普通的黑色大众，开车小伙又是一个沉默寡言的家伙，全程一句话没说。

来的时候也是这样，这是不是保密部门的特色。

车开到三环边上，顾承安便让他靠边停下了。

“到这就行，谢了。”

小伙点了点头，等他下车后一脚油门就走了，那叫一个干脆利落。

顾承安站在路边看着远去的尾灯，很想问一句：

“我有那么可怕吗！”

他的背上多了一个比来时大了两号的背包，塞得跟腊月里的行李袋似的，鼓鼓囊囊的。

往肩上颠了颠，心想这要是走在路上被人拦下来检查，就里面那堆东西够他解释到明天早上了。

他想起离开基地前的那一幕，嘴角不自觉地翘了起来。

温良把他堵在装备处门口，脸色铁青。

事情的起因很简单——他在装备处领完常规装备后，目光被角落里一个铁皮柜吸引住了，柜门里面整整齐齐码着一排各式手雷。

他当时就走不动道了。

装备处的人被他磨了好一会，松了口：“你要是有处长的条子……”

话还没说完，温良就站在门口了。

“你在干什么？”

“处长，我就想领几枚手雷，以备不时之需——”

“你怎么携带？放裤裆里？”

“……”

“你当你是谁？兰博？”

温良当场发飙了，指着墙上贴着的《警械武器使用管理条例》，让他从头到尾背十遍。

顾承安站在那背了二十多分钟。

一字不差地背完，温良脸色才缓和了一点。

“007，你给我记住——你领走的每一件东西，都是记录在册的。还想领手雷，丢一个会有什么后果？你知道吗？你拿命来赔啊。”

“处长放心，丢不了的。”

这话他只能在心里面想一下。

他的系统空间虽然只有一立方米。放不下一辆车，但塞这些家伙绰绰有余的。

他自己丢了，里面的东西都丢不了。

Gu Chengan took the base's official car back to the city.

It was just an ordinary black Volkswagen, and the guy driving it was a taciturn guy who didn't say a word the whole time.

It was like this when I arrived. Isn't this a characteristic of the confidentiality department?

When the car reached the third ring road, Gu Chengan asked him to pull over and stop.

"That's all, thanks."

The young man nodded, waited for him to get off the car, stepped on the accelerator and left, which was called a clean and tidy thing.

Gu Chengan stood on the roadside and looked at the tail lights in the distance, wanting to ask:

"Am I that scary?"

There was a backpack on his back that was two sizes larger than when he arrived. It was as stuffed as a duffel bag in the twelfth lunar month and was bulging.

He put it on his shoulder, thinking that if he were stopped and inspected while walking on the road, the pile of things inside would be enough for him to explain until tomorrow morning.

He recalled the scene before leaving the base, and the corners of his mouth curled up unconsciously.

Wen Liang blocked him at the door of the equipment department, his face ashen.

The cause of the matter is simple - after he received the regular equipment at the equipment department, his eyes were attracted by a metal cabinet in the corner, with a row of various grenades neatly stacked inside the cabinet door.

He couldn't walk anymore.

The person in the equipment department was troubled by him for a while, and then he relaxed: "If you have a note from the director..."

Before he finished speaking, Wen Liang stood at the door.

"What are you doing?"

"Director, I just want to get a few grenades in case of emergency——"

"How do you carry it? Put it in your crotch?"

"..."

"Who do you think you are? Rambo?"

Wen Liang became furious on the spot. He pointed at the "Regulations on the Use of Police Weapons" posted on the wall and asked him to recite it from beginning to end ten times.

Gu Chengan stood there carrying it for more than twenty minutes.

After reciting it word for word, Wen Liang's expression softened a little.

"007, please remember - everything you take away is recorded in the book. You still want to receive a grenade, what will be the consequences of losing one? Do you know? You have to pay with your life."

"Don't worry, Director, you can't lose it."

He could only think about this in his heart.

Although his system space is only one cubic meter.Not enough room for a car, but more than enough for these guys.

If he throws it away himself, nothing inside will be lost.
